An Infirmary adds InfirmaryEvacBonusSols.

Name: HopeBase

Name: HopePerMoralePoint
Notes: M2 Gate B: Hope per MoraleWeight point for each functioning room type per rated floor (Living excluded - housing covers it). Crew-phase D3a (2026-10-17): halved per director ruling D3a (sweep C) - THRIVING is the normal good state, FLOURISHING takes extra care. C2a (2026-10-18): now counted ONCE per room function colony-wide, times min(1, rooms of that function x RoomServesResidents / population).

Name: HopePerJob
Notes: M2 Gate B: Hope per colonist holding a job seat (one seat per Lab/Workstation cell). Crew-phase D3a (2026-10-17): halved per director ruling D3a (sweep C) - THRIVING is the normal good state, FLOURISHING takes extra care. RETIRED by C2a - unused: replaced by HopeJobsMax (an employment rate).

Name: HopeAdjacencyPenalty

Name: HopeUnsupportedPenalty
Notes: M2 Gate B: Hope lost per currently-unsupported colonist RETIRED by C2a - unused: replaced by HopeUnsupportedMax x HopeUnsupportedSteepness (a share of the colony short of a full ration).

Name: HopeVaultMilestone

Name: GardenSoilKgPerCell

Name: GardenSeedsKgPerCell

Name: GardenWaterKgPerSolPerCell

Name: HopeLuxuryBonus

Name: HopeSmoothTauSols
Notes: M2 Gate D+: Hope low-pass time constant - the colony's mood catches up to the instantaneous index over ~this many sols (exp smoother, band-parity-safe)

Name: HopeTempoSlope

Name: HopeTempoMin
Notes: M2 Gate D+: work-tempo FLOOR - a strained colony is slow, never dead (death-spiral guardrail, mental-health directive)

Name: HopeTempoMax
Notes: M2 Gate D+: work-tempo ceiling - a flourishing crew's upside

Name: HopeFailingEnter
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope falls to FAILING band below this (down-threshold of the Failing|Strained edge)

Name: HopeStrainedEnter
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope rises to STRAINED above this (up-threshold; 8-pt hysteresis gap vs HopeFailingEnter)

Name: HopeStrainedExit
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope falls to STRAINED below this (down-threshold of the Strained|Steady edge)

Name: HopeSteadyEnter
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope rises to STEADY above this (up-threshold; 10-pt hysteresis)

Name: HopeThrivingExit
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope falls out of THRIVING below this

Name: HopeThrivingEnter
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope rises to THRIVING above this (5-pt hysteresis)

Name: HopeFlourishingExit
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope falls out of FLOURISHING below this

Name: HopeFlourishingEnter
Notes: M2 Gate D+: smoothed Hope rises to FLOURISHING above this (the discovery/growth band, 5-pt hysteresis)

Name: GardenGrowLightWPerCell
Notes: M2 Gate D+ garden fork: grow-light power draw per planted GARDEN cell, debited from the battery each step; if the bank cannot pay, the cell goes dark (dormant, not dead) - grow crops cost energy, plan the grid before settlers

Name: GreenhouseGlassKgPerCell
Notes: M2 Gate D+ garden fork: Glass consumed to plant one Greenhouse cell (one GlassCrate glazes 2 cells)

Name: GreenhouseMinLevel
Notes: M2 Gate D+ garden fork: a Greenhouse gets sunlight only on floors at or above this level (-1 = shallowest carved); deeper greenhouses sit dark

Name: ColonistWaterKgPerSol
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: potable-water draw per colonist per sol; joins the life-support contract (no water = unsupported, same abstract evac path as air/food)

Name: GreywaterReturnFraction
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: fraction of a colonist water draw reclaimed back to the pool by recycling - stretches supply, but the reclaimed water degrades potability

Name: WaterPotabilityDecayPerSol
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: potability lost per sol while a crew recycles (you can drink filtered greywater only so many times)

Name: WaterPotabilityRestorePerKg
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: potability restored per kg of FRESH ice-melt water entering the pool (linear = era-parity-safe); makes ice-cap drilling the standing imperative

Name: WaterPotabilityFloor
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: below this potability the crew takes a Hope penalty (grim recycled water saps morale) - the first scarcity-driven Hope input

Name: HopeWaterPenalty
Notes: M2 Gate D+ water loop: max Hope lost at zero potability, scaled by how far below the floor (prevention-framed morale pressure, not a death spiral)

Name: IceLowAlertFraction
Notes: D2a (director, 2026-10-17): a discovered ice deposit announces RUNNING LOW once when its remaining mass falls below this share of its surveyed mass (Ice_A 30 t -> 7.5 t); 0 disables. Placeholder, director review

Name: IceWaterPlantNear_m
Notes: D2a (director, 2026-10-17): a finished Water Plant within this distance of a drilled ice deposit counts as melting it where it is drilled; with none, the guide asks for one (hauls go to the nearest plant). Placeholder, director review

Name: HopeGrowthThreshold
Notes: M2 Gate D+ generational carrot: smoothed Hope at/above this (the THRIVING band) lets the colony grow - births are earned by sustained flourishing

Name: HopeGrowthIntervalSols
Notes: M2 Gate D+ generational carrot: sustained eligible sols per new colonist (a birth); the streak resets if conditions lapse - momentum is earned, not banked

Name: HopeGrowthFoodBufferSols
Notes: M2 Gate D+ generational carrot: required Food buffer (in sols of colony draw) before the colony will grow - you do not birth into a famine

Name: HopeFirstBornMilestone
Notes: M2 Gate D+ generational carrot: one-time Hope bonus once the FIRST Martian-born child arrives (never retracts) - the brief milestone + M3 identity-axis seed

Name: HopeDiscoveryThreshold
Notes: M2 Gate D+ discoveries: smoothed Hope at/above this lets staffed Labs accrue research seat-hours toward the next ordered discovery - breakthroughs are earned by sustained flourishing, not a grind

Name: ConvoySpeedKmPerSol
Notes: M3 Gate A: rover convoy speed under clear sky; an active dust storm FREEZES transit (brief: routes disrupted by storms)

Name: ConvoyH2PerRun
Notes: M3 Gate A: hydrogen burned per convoy round trip, committed at departure (the Borer batch pattern) - trade runs on the fuel economy

Name: ConvoyWearParts
Notes: M3 Gate A: SpareParts consumed per convoy round trip (vehicle wear, the director's trek cost) - committed at departure

Name: RelationPerRun
Notes: M3 Gate A: relation warmed per completed convoy run (0..100 per rival) - the dependency scalar the Solidarity Dilemma later leverages

Name: EarthTensionStart
Notes: M3 Gate B: opening Earth-tension (0..100). Rises with off-screen conflict; the pressure behind the Solidarity Dilemma

Name: EarthTensionDriftPerSol
Notes: M3 Gate B: background tension rise per sol once you have neighbors - Earth grows uneasy as Mars connects to itself

Name: EarthTensionDemandThreshold
Notes: M3 Gate B: tension at/above this generates a demand from your sponsor nation (the hook Gate C resolves via Comply/Defy)

Name: IdentityAxisStart
Notes: M3 Gate B: the Earth-Aligned(-100) .. Martian-Identity(+100) axis; 0 = a loyal corporate colony. Comply/Defy (Gate C) move it; it gates the endings

Name: RequisitionEarthBonus
Notes: M3 Gate B: at full Earth-alignment, supply-ship awards are this fraction LARGER (loyalty is rewarded)

Name: RequisitionMartianPenalty
Notes: M3 Gate B: at full Martian-identity, Earth awards shrink by this fraction (toward denied requisitions)

Name: RequisitionTensionPenalty
Notes: M3 Gate B: at full Earth-tension, awards shrink by this fraction (Earth hoards during a crisis)

Name: DilemmaComplyAxisShift
Notes: M3 Gate C: identity axis moved toward EARTH (-) when you COMPLY (cut trade to satisfy your sponsor nation)

Name: DilemmaDefyAxisShift
Notes: M3 Gate C: identity axis moved toward MARTIAN (+) when you DEFY (keep trading in solidarity)

Name: DilemmaComplyTensionDrop
Notes: M3 Gate C: Earth tension relieved on COMPLY (the demand is satisfied - a long calm before the next)

Name: DilemmaDefyTensionDrop
Notes: M3 Gate C: small tension relief on DEFY - it keeps climbing, so the next demand comes sooner (escalation)

Name: DilemmaRelationHit
Notes: M3 Gate C: relation lost with each rival whose route you CLOSE on Comply (on top of the route itself closing)

Name: DilemmaDefyRelationBonus
Notes: M3 Gate C: relation warmed with every rival on DEFY (pan-Martian solidarity)

Name: SolidarityHopeShock
Notes: M3 Gate C: the immediate colonist-morale swing on a Dilemma choice (- on Comply, community shrank; + on Defy, solidarity) - a fading shock

Name: SolidarityHopeTauSols
Notes: M3 Gate C: the morale shock fades toward zero over ~this many sols (exp decay, parity-safe)

Name: HumanNatureStart
Notes: M4 Gate A: the Evolved/Diplomatic(+100)..Destructive/Predatory(-100) axis - HOW you treat others. Fair trade/pacify/aid push +, theft/sabotage/coercion push -. Gates which late-game crisis spawns

Name: HumanNatureFairTradeShift
Notes: M4 Gate A: axis moved toward EVOLVED (+) per completed honest trade convoy - fair dealing is rewarded

Name: HumanNatureCovertShift
Notes: M4 Gate A: axis moved toward DESTRUCTIVE (-) per covert-requisition attempt (whether caught or clean - the intent is what marks you)

Name: CovertLotFraction
Notes: M4 Gate A: a covert requisition steals this fraction of a rival export lot (less than an honest trade, but you pay nothing)

Name: CovertDetectionBase
Notes: M4 Gate A: base chance a covert op is DETECTED at neutral relation, daytime; the deterministic (seeded) roll compares against this

Name: CovertDetectionTrustMul
Notes: M4 Gate A: how much high Public_Standing LOWERS detection - betraying a trusting ally is easy (P *= 1 - relation/100 * this). The moral trap

Name: CovertDetectionNightMul
Notes: M4 Gate A: detection multiplier at NIGHT (fewer eyes) - Module 2 day/night visibility, folded into the covert roll

Name: CovertHiddenTensionClean
Notes: M4 Gate A: HiddenTension gained with a rival on a CLEAN covert job (they suspect, quietly)

Name: CovertHiddenTensionCaught
Notes: M4 Gate A: HiddenTension spike when a covert op is CAUGHT (an incident)

Name: CovertRelationHitCaught
Notes: M4 Gate A: Public_Standing lost when a covert op is caught (the open breach)

Name: LaunderHiddenDrop
Notes: M4 Gate B: HiddenTension defused per laundering (trade stolen goods back as a peace offering) - buying back a secret grudge

Name: LaunderRelationBonus
Notes: M4 Gate B: Public_Standing warmed per laundering (the visible goodwill of returning goods)

Name: HumanNatureLaunderShift
Notes: M4 Gate B: HumanNature toward EVOLVED (+) per laundering - making amends is who you choose to be

Name: HumanNatureSabotageShift
Notes: M4 Gate B: HumanNature toward DESTRUCTIVE (-) per sabotage attempt - a hostile act marks you harder than theft

Name: SabotageDurationSols
Notes: M4 Gate B: how long a landed sabotage disrupts a rival - their production/trade is offline (a deterministic blackout, never combat)

Name: SabotageHiddenTension
Notes: M4 Gate B: HiddenTension the target gains when sabotaged (they know they were hit)

Name: DiscoveryChancePerSurvey
Notes: M4 Gate B: deterministic chance a survey uncovers the next dormant settlement (seeded by survey count) - scouting opens new diplomacy

Name: InfluenceStart
Notes: M4 Gate C: opening diplomatic influence - the soft currency spent to pacify Earth-ordered embargoes

Name: InfluencePerTrade
Notes: M4 Gate C: influence earned per completed honest trade convoy (fair dealing builds standing)

Name: InfluencePerLaunder
Notes: M4 Gate C: influence earned per laundering (visible goodwill)

Name: InfluenceDriftPerSol
Notes: M4 Gate C: passive influence per sol, scaled by positive HumanNature - the Evolved path earns the tools of diplomacy

Name: EarthPreemptiveThreshold
Notes: M4 Gate C: Earth tension at/above which Earth turns a NEIGHBOR against you (an embargo) - higher than the Solidarity demand (60), an escalation

Name: EmbargoGraceSols
Notes: M4 Gate C: sols to pacify an Earth-ordered embargo before it hardens into a permanent DEFECTION

Name: PacifyInfluenceCost
Notes: M4 Gate C: influence spent to pacify an embargo - the colony sees reason and ignores Earth

Name: PacifyTensionRelief
Notes: M4 Gate C: Earth tension eased when you successfully pacify (a de-escalation)

Name: HumanNaturePacifyShift
Notes: M4 Gate C: HumanNature toward EVOLVED (+) per pacification - choosing reason over confrontation

Name: DefectRelationFloor
Notes: M4 Gate C: relation a rival is locked to when it DEFECTS under Earth pressure (hostile, trade closed)

Name: CrisisIntervalSols
Notes: M4 Gate D: sols between crisis checks once the late game is live (has neighbors) - a seeded roll each interval decides if one fires

Name: CrisisChance
Notes: M4 Gate D: chance a crisis fires at an interval check (deterministic seeded roll by crisis count) - not metronomic

Name: CrisisDurationSols
Notes: M4 Gate D: how long a crisis lasts before the colony recovers (deterministic downtime, never permanent)

Name: CrisisAlignmentThreshold
Notes: M4 Gate D: the HumanNature split - below this a DESTRUCTIVE colony draws a Malfunction (self-inflicted blackout/robot downtime); at/above, an EVOLVED colony draws an Environmental test

Name: CrisisWorkPenalty
Notes: M4 Gate D: human work-tempo multiplier during a Malfunction crisis (automation stutters, units go inert and need reset - NEVER feral)

Name: CrisisMalfunctionHope
Notes: M4 Gate D: Hope penalty while a Malfunction crisis runs (unrest as systems fail)

Name: CrisisEnvironmentHope
Notes: M4 Gate D: Hope penalty while an Environmental crisis runs (strain, but the colony pulls together)

Name: CrisisWaterDrainPerSol
Notes: M4 Gate D: extra Water drained per sol during an Environmental crisis (a systems-stress test survivable with reserves)

Name: EndingIdentityThreshold
Notes: M4 Gate D: |IdentityAxis| at which the colony has a DEFINITE Earth/Mars allegiance for the endings read

Name: EndingHumanNatureThreshold
Notes: M4 Gate D: HumanNature magnitude separating an Evolved federation ending from a Destructive cold-war ending

Name: SkillMasterySols
Notes: Alive pass: sols worked at one job to reach mastery - output multiplier ramps linearly 1x -> 2x (a master gardener/scientist doubles their yield)

Name: CrewMomentIntervalSols
Notes: Alive pass: cadence of crew-life moments (pastimes, join-ins, disputes) - one seeded moment roughly twice a sol

Name: DisputeHopeBelow

Name: FirstHarvestKg
Notes: Alive pass: cumulative garden-grown Food that marks THE FIRST MARTIAN HARVEST milestone (crew celebration + permanent Hope)

Name: HopeFirstHarvestMilestone
Notes: Alive pass: permanent Hope milestone for the first Martian-grown harvest - food from OUR soil

Name: EpilogueSustainSols
Notes: v25 ending resolution: sols the declared path must HOLD (projected ending == declared) before the one-time EPILOGUE card; wavering resets the clock. Balance placeholder

Name: WeatherCycleSols

Name: InfirmaryEvacBonusSols
Notes: v25 tiers Gate A: extra evacuation-countdown grace while an Infirmary cell is online on a rated floor (prevention framing - more time to fix the fault)

Name: WorkstationFabBonusPerSeat

Name: CropSoilDepleteKgPerSol
Notes: agri Gate B: bed soil spent per MATURE producing cell-sol (250 kg bed = 10 sols); crops-dormant colonies never touch it

Name: FertilizerSoilPerKg
Notes: agri Gate B: bed soil restored per kg Fertilizer worked in (250 kg bed = 125 kg fertilizer)

Name: CompostKgPerColonistSol
Notes: agri Gate B: abstract recycling accumulator per colonist-sol while crops are live (Gate-D safe wording)

Name: SpoilChemFraction
Notes: agri Gate B: chemical fraction of fresh dig spoil banked for the fertilizer chain while crops are live

Name: ClimateMismatchYieldMul
Notes: agri Gate B: crop yield multiplier when its ClimateBand differs from the floor's effective climate

Name: DuctYieldBonusMul
Notes: agri Gate D: ducted-garden yield multiplier while the colony CO2 pool covers the draw

Name: GardenCO2DrawKgPerSolPerCell
Notes: agri Gate D: CO2 a ducted producing cell draws from the colony pool

Name: GardenO2EmitKgPerSolPerCell
Notes: agri Gate D: O2 a ducted producing cell returns to colony stock when its CO2 draw is met

Name: CO2KgPerColonistSol
Notes: agri Gate D: exhaled CO2 pooled per colonist-sol while crops are live (feeds ducted gardens)

Name: ShaftLinkRange_m

Name: FurnitureRefundFraction

Name: HopeFurnishingsMax

Name: HopeViewsMax
Notes: BM-6 (2026-10-16): cap on the bonus-only Views line - the summed HopeViews of windows in rated surface habitats. Placeholder, director review

Notes: D4a (2026-10-17): max Hope lost when the larder is empty, linear in how far the food runway (stock / colony draw) sits below FoodRunwayFloorSols - same shape as HopeWaterPenalty; a soft cap, prevention-framed pressure. Placeholder, director review
